hero.description: Apsara Wallet is a personal finance app for Cambodia. Track spending across multiple wallets in riel and dollars, scan receipts on your device, set budgets that actually hold, and see where your money goes.
hero.panelDescription: The essentials, done properly — not a spreadsheet with a logo on it.

features.heading: Everything you need to run your money
features.description: Each feature exists because tracking money in Cambodia has its own shape — two currencies, cash-heavy spending, and receipts that come on paper.
features.walletsBody: Keep cash, bank and mobile-money balances apart. Move money between your own wallets without it polluting your income and expense totals.
features.transactionsBody: Log an expense in seconds with categories, notes and your choice of riel or dollars. Search, filter by category and date, then export the result to CSV.
features.receiptsBody: Point your camera at a receipt and the amount, date and merchant are read on your device. Nothing is uploaded to be parsed.
features.budgetsBody: Set a monthly limit per category. Spending is measured against it from your real ledger, so the number on your dashboard is the truth.
features.savingsBody: Name a goal, set a target, and track progress toward it. Goals are tracking-only — they never quietly move your money around.
features.analyticsBody: See a category breakdown, your biggest spend areas and a daily or monthly trend. Insights are computed on your device from your own ledger.

howItWorks.heading: Three steps to a real picture
howItWorks.description: No bank linking, no paperwork, no waiting for approval. You are recording your own money.
howItWorks.stepOneBody: Add one wallet per place you actually keep money — cash in hand, your bank account, your mobile wallet. Set the opening balance and you are done.
howItWorks.stepTwoBody: Add transactions by hand or scan the receipt. Set up recurring entries for rent and subscriptions so they post themselves.
howItWorks.stepThreeBody: Budgets, analytics and insights update from the same ledger. Adjust, and watch next month look different.

security.heading: Your ledger stays yours
security.description: A finance app earns trust by what it refuses to do. Here is what Apsara Wallet refuses.
security.lockBody: Turn on a PIN or your fingerprint or Face ID. The app locks on launch and whenever it returns from the background.
security.onDeviceBody: Receipt scanning and spending insights run on your phone. Your raw receipts and your spending patterns are not sent away to be analysed.
security.noSellingBody: We do not sell your personal or financial data to third parties. There is no advertising business behind this app.
security.deleteBody: Delete your account from inside the app, or request deletion here on the web. Your data goes with it.

faq.heading: The things people ask first
faq.description: Short answers to what usually decides whether an app like this is worth installing.
faq.moreLabel: Still stuck? Read the full support page
faq.priceBody: Yes. Every feature described on this page is free to use. There are no ads, and we do not sell your personal or financial data.
faq.bankTitle: Do I have to connect my bank account?
faq.bankBody: No. There is no bank linking and no paperwork. You create a wallet for each place you keep money and record what you spend — which is also why it works for cash.
faq.currencyTitle: Can I use riel and dollars together?
faq.currencyBody: Yes. Enter each transaction in the currency you actually paid in. Exchange rates come from our server, so totals across both currencies stay consistent.
faq.offlineBody: Your last loaded wallets, transactions, categories and budget stay readable offline. New entries need a connection to sync.
faq.receiptsTitle: Where do my scanned receipts go?
faq.receiptsBody: Nowhere. Receipt text is read by your phone, and the amount, date and merchant are filled in for you to check. The image is not uploaded to be parsed.
faq.exitTitle: Can I get my data out, or delete it?
faq.exitBody: Both. Export the transactions you are looking at to CSV at any time, and delete your account with everything in it from inside the app or from this site.

cta.heading: Start tracking this month
cta.description: Free to use. Khmer and English. No bank account required.

footer.description: A personal finance app built for Cambodia — multi-wallet, bilingual, and private by default.

support.title: Support
support.intro: Something not working, or a question about your account? Start here — most answers are one section away.
support.contactBody: Email us and we will reply within two business days. Tell us your app version (Profile → About → App Version) and what you were doing when the problem happened.
support.faqResetBody: On the login screen, tap Forgot password and follow the reset flow. If you are still locked out, email us from the address on your account.
support.faqPinBody: The app-lock PIN is stored only on your device and cannot be recovered by us. Reinstall the app and sign in again — your data is on the server, not in the PIN.
support.faqCurrencyTitle: How does riel and dollar conversion work?
support.faqCurrencyBody: You enter each transaction in the currency you actually paid in. Exchange rates are fetched from our server so totals across currencies stay consistent.
support.faqOfflineBody: Your last loaded wallets, transactions, categories and budget stay readable offline. New entries need a connection to sync.
support.faqExportTitle: Can I get my data out?
support.faqExportBody: Yes. Open Transaction History and use the export action to produce a CSV of the transactions currently shown, then share it wherever you like.
support.faqDeleteTitle: How do I delete my account?
support.faqDeleteBody: Profile → Security → Delete Account, confirmed with your password. Or use the web request form if you no longer have the app installed.

deleteAccount.title: Delete your account
deleteAccount.intro: You can delete your Apsara Wallet account and its data at any time. The fastest way is from inside the app; the form below is for when you no longer have it installed.
deleteAccount.inAppStepOne: Open Apsara Wallet and sign in.
deleteAccount.inAppStepThree: Tap Delete Account and confirm with your password.
deleteAccount.inAppNote: Deletion happens immediately and cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.webBody: Email us from the address registered on your account with the subject "Delete my account". We will verify that you own the address and complete the deletion within 30 days.
deleteAccount.dataTransactions: Every transaction, transfer and receipt record
deleteAccount.dataBudgets: Budgets, savings goals and custom categories
deleteAccount.dataProfile: Your profile, credentials and notification settings
deleteAccount.retainedBody: Records we are required to retain by law, and anonymous aggregate counts that cannot be traced back to you.
deleteAccount.exportTip: Want a copy first? Export your transactions to CSV from Transaction History before you delete — we cannot recover the data afterwards.
